It is suitable for those who want to increase the number of participants in a bot as well as boost referrals via special links. Note that referrals to bots and referrals to Telegram Mini Apps are different features. Setup process: Use a database If the «Use Database» option is enabled, you need to specify the path to the database that contains the list of bot links. For example, if you have already worked on this task but didn’t complete it, you can use the database that the software automatically created during the previous attempt. If the option is disabled, you must manually input links in the format: one link per line. Delay between joining Set the pause between subscriptions for one account to multiple bots. If multiple bots are assigned to a single account, the delay regulates the subscription speed. It is better to set this delay to avoid bans or suspicious activity. Maximum timeout (FloodWait) Specify the timeout when encountering flood restrictions. If the restriction exceeds the time you set, the account’s operation will stop. If the restriction is shorter, the software will wait and continue the task. Select accounts Specify the accounts that will be subscribed to the bot. Unique subscriptions (multiple bots to one account) Configure this option so that each account subscribes only to unique bots from the list. For example, if you have 10 accounts and 100 links and set 10 unique subscriptions, each account will subscribe to 10 links. There will be no overlap, only unique values. Multiple subscriptions (multiple accounts to one bot) Using this option, you can subscribe multiple accounts to the same bots. For instance, if you want to subscribe 6 accounts to 2 bots, all of them will be subscribed to the same list. Streams control In multi-threaded mode, set the number of threads, and the system will engage the corresponding number of accounts. For example, with 11 threads, 11 accounts will be active simultaneously. The program automatically selects the next account as soon as one completes its task, adhering to the specified interval range, such as 20 to 45 seconds (randomly selected within the range). The module in Telegram Expert will start subscribing accounts to the specified bots. Upon completion, users receive notifications from the bots if the subscription was made via a referral link. All actions performed are displayed in the program’s log. The module works only with standard referral links like https://t.me/username_bot?start=11111111 and does not work with Mini App links (Telegram applications).
